Start with this repository's `AGENTS.md`, `.michelslab/project.yml`, `MICHELS_LAB_PROJECT.md`, current product log(s) (docs/GIT_AUDIT_LOG.md; docs/DEVELOPMENT_PLAN_FIELD_REGIONS_AND_CAD_2026-10-19.md), current code/UX evidence, and canonical `michels-lab/Michel-Software-Standards/standards/PERSPECTIVE_COUNCIL_STANDARD.md`. If master cross-repo access is absent, state it. **Scientific OpenFOAM case inspection, 2D/3D Field, Data, Analysis, CAD/mesh, time series, phase change and numerical provenance on Windows/local Web.** Do not confuse hypothesized opportunities with shipped or runtime-verified capabilities.

Consider provenance-aware case summaries, field-unit diagnostics, mesh consistency checks, conservative validation, evidence-linked insight recommendations and deterministic scientific QA before AI conclusions. Analyze data quality, security/permission boundaries, offline/error recovery, observability, scalability, platform constraints and transferability to other Michel's Lab products. Compare AI solutions with explicit simpler rules. Every idea needs source data, cost, privacy/consent, failure mode, user override, fallback, measurement and a reason **not** to build it. Never misstate provider/physical/scientific evidence or auto-edit app code.
